teaser: The smell of cut lumber and fresh paint hangs over the hardware store aisle, and you are reading the back of a box of screws like it owes you an explanation. Life path 4 and ESFJ meet here, in the part of you that wants a thing built right and wants everyone in the house to feel safe once it is. The 4 asks for structure that holds; the ESFJ asks for people to feel cared for inside that structure. In you those two needs rarely compete. What this crossing asks is whether the structure you keep tending is also the one you would have chosen, or just the one that needed tending first.
